g.text: Post-outcome literature-focused display; not an unbiased ranking
Dots: primary estimates. Lines: extrema across 11 separate library omissions, pseudocounts 0.5/2, and primary.
Sensitivity ranges are not confidence intervals. Areg/Il2ra are informative non-robust references; Pde3b is a prior-paper anchor.
